chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Dawud narrated from Salamah ibn Muhammad, who said: 'Ahmad ibn Ali Aban al-Qummi informed us from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Isa, from al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Washsha, from al-Rida (peace be upon him):'
He said: 'I asked him about the visitation of the grave of Abu al-Hasan (peace be upon him), is it like the visitation of the grave of al-Husayn (peace be upon him)?' He said, 'Yes.'
ai.seo_question: Is the reward for visiting Imam Hasan's grave equal to visiting Imam Husayn's grave?
ai.summary: Imam al-Rida (peace be upon him) affirms the equivalence in spiritual merit between visiting the grave of Imam al-Hasan (peace be upon him) and that of Imam al-Husayn (peace be upon him), highlighting the shared status of the two grandsons of the Prophet. This narration, recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, underscores the continuity of reverence for the Ahl al-Bayt across generations, linking the martyrdom of al-Husayn with the dignified legacy of al-Hasan. It serves as a foundational text for Shia devotional practices, encouraging pilgrims to seek blessings at the shrines of both Imams with equal devotion.
